爱莎贝儿-163CM-L 粉肤 AHRC032 绪方舞香Ogata Maika-陷落
她陷在沙发里，舞裙沿着腿弯滑落。
指尖在皮质扶手上划出细微声响，像某种邀请。
歪着头看你时，锁骨凹陷处盛着一小片光影。
“过来，”她说。声音是哑的，混着栀子花香。
脚趾轻轻蹭过你的裤脚，往上，再往上。
沙发发出柔软的叹息，她整个人陷得更深，却把目光钉在你身上，灼热而潮湿。
身型: 163CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-163CM-L Pink AHRC032, Ogata Maika-Sinking
She sank into the sofa, her dance skirt sliding down her legs.
Her fingertips traced subtle sounds on the leather armrests, like an invitation.
Tilting her head to look at you, a small patch of light and shadow played in the hollow of her collarbone.
“Come here,” she said. Her voice was hoarse, tinged with the scent of gardenias.
Her toes lightly brushed against your trouser leg, upwards, and upwards again.
The sofa sighed softly, and she sank even deeper, her gaze fixed on you, hot and wet.
Body type: 163CM-L with Pink skin tone.
